texts.preamble: Jauli vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 November, 2023 Author: Samit Gopal Bench: Samit Gopal High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:221886 Court No. - 69 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 2340 of 2014 Revisionist :- Jauli Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Revisionist :- Raj Kumar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt.Advocate Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J. 1.
texts.facts: The case of the prosecution is that the Food Inspector Yaduveer Singh during investigation found the revisionist to be carrying two containers containing 70 liter milk. The revisionist was stopped and introduction was given to him by the Food Inspector after which on a suspicion of adulteration 1.5 liter of milk was purchased by the Food Inspector and the same was sealed in three empty bottles and the required formalities were done and the sample was sent for analysis to the Food Analyst who vide his report opined that in the sample the quantity of milk solid not fat is less than 6% from the prescribed standard. He completed the formalities and filed a complaint against the revisionist. The notice regarding the same was sent to the revisionist. After filing the complaint, the complainant was examined as P.W.-1 before the trial court. He corroborated the prosecution story. The revisionist was convicted as stated above and appeal was filed against the said conviction to which the present revision has been filed.
texts.arguments: 5. Learned counsel for the revisionist argued that the material as collected by the Food Inspector was mixed milk. There is nothing on record to show that the milk is homogenized and stirred. It is argued that when the milk is not homogenized and stirred the same would have variation in the fat as the fat would normally settle down. It is argued that the said argument was taken before the trial court but the trial court returned the finding that it was the responsibility of the seller to homogenize and stir the material and not of the purchaser. It is argued that the said view is totally illegal and arbitrary. It is argued that as such conviction and sentence as awarded to the revisionist be set-aside, judgement & order of the trial court be set-aside and also the judgement & order of the appellate court be set-aside. 6. Per contra, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer and arguments and argued that the trial court has given cogent reasons for convicting the revisionist.
